meta.name: English
meta.review_note: Written in English by the developer. Not clinically reviewed.

app.name: AuraHealth
app.tagline: A clearer path to human help.
app.prototype: Prototype for simulated use only. Not a medical device.
emergency.title: Call emergency services
emergency.body: {number} is India's emergency number for police, fire and medical help.
emergency.needsNetwork: A call needs mobile network coverage. AuraHealth cannot place calls without it.
emergency.dialerNote: Tapping opens your phone's dialer. Nothing is called automatically.
emergency.showCard: When they answer, you can read out or show your handoff card.
home.intro: AuraHealth helps you put what happened into a clear card you can show or read to an emergency operator or a doctor.
home.how1: Answer a few short questions. "I don't know" is always fine.
home.how2: Optionally add a report. A local model reads it and you check every field.
home.how3: Get a handoff card that shows where every detail came from.
status.title: Status
status.offlineNote: The handoff works without internet. Models run on the laptop, not on the phone.
lang.label: Language
region.label: Region
who.title: Who needs help?
who.labelHint: For example "my father" or "neighbour". No full name needed.
age.title: About how old are they?
what.title: What happened? What do you see?
what.hint: Describe it in your own words. Short is fine.
what.placeholder: For example: my neighbour slipped on the stairs about ten minutes ago and is holding her wrist
what.assistNote: A local model splits your own words into points. It can't add anything: every point must be your exact words, and AuraHealth checks that.
what.assistUnavailable: The text helper isn't available, so your description is kept as you wrote it.
what.assistLanguage: The text helper works in English in this prototype. Your description is kept as you wrote it.
what.pointsHint: Keep the points that are right. Remove any you don't want.
what.dropped: {count} suggestion(s) were left out because they weren't your exact words.
what.keepWhole: Use my whole description as one point
onset.title: When did it start?
details.title: Anything you want to include?
details.hint: Only add what you are sure about. Leave the rest empty.
details.other: Anything else the professional should know
doc.title: Add a report (optional)
doc.hint: A photo or file of a medical report. In this prototype, use only the synthetic sample reports.
doc.read: Read it with the local model
doc.reading: Reading on the laptop… this can take a few minutes.
doc.readFailed: The report couldn't be read automatically. You can type the details yourself.
doc.readerMissing: The report reader model isn't installed on this laptop. You can type the details yourself.
doc.warning: The model can misread. Check every field against the image before confirming.
doc.flag: This looks like an instruction. AuraHealth never follows text found in documents; it is shown only as written.
doc.reportDateQuestion: Is this report current for this situation?
doc.unconfirmedNote: Unconfirmed fields are not added to the handoff.
review.title: Your handoff card
review.evidenceHint: Tap any line to see where it came from.
card.details: Details the user chose to include
card.report: From a report (confirmed by the user)
card.reportCurrent: User says this report is current
card.reportNotCurrent: User is not sure this report is current
card.notAssessed: AuraHealth has not assessed this situation and gives no diagnosis or advice.
prov.userSplit: Your words, split by the text helper
evidence.title: Where this came from
evidence.noBoxes: AuraHealth doesn't mark exact positions on the image. Compare with the original.
share.note: Nothing is sent anywhere. You choose what to show or share.
cannot.title: AuraHealth can't assess this situation
cannot.body: It doesn't give a diagnosis, tell you it is safe to wait, or advise treatment. If you are worried, contact {number} or a healthcare professional.
privacy.title: Your data
privacy.body: Your answers are saved only on this laptop, in a local file that is not encrypted. There are no accounts, no analytics and no uploads to the internet.
privacy.lan: Anyone on the same Wi-Fi who has the pairing link could open this app. Use a trusted network.
privacy.deleteConfirm: Delete all answers and report images from this laptop?
about.title: About this prototype
about.body: AuraHealth is a hackathon research prototype. It organises what a person says and confirms. It is not a doctor, not a triage system, and not clinically validated. Do not use it with real patients.
server.down: The laptop server isn't reachable. The emergency call above still works.
home.replaceConfirm: Start again? This deletes the saved handoff on this laptop.
what.flag: This reads like an instruction. AuraHealth doesn't follow it; it is kept only as your words.
what.edited: You changed the description, so the split points were cleared. Split again if you like.
what.noPoints: The text helper didn't return any of your exact words, so your description is kept as you wrote it.
doc.timing: Read in {seconds} s on this laptop ({model}).
doc.noFieldsYet: No fields yet. Add the ones you can read on the image.
doc.uploadFailed: That file couldn't be used. Choose a photo or image file.
status.lanOn: Wi-Fi mode: paired phones on this network can connect
evidence.helperModel: Split by {model}. The words are yours.
about.voice: No voice input or read-aloud in this prototype: browser speech features are not guaranteed to work offline.
what.uncovered: {count} part(s) of your words were not in any point, so they were added as you wrote them.
home.helpNote: Step-by-step first aid while you wait for help, adapted from Red Cross guidelines.
help.title: What is happening?
help.hint: If you can, call {number} first. Then pick what you see.
help.englishOnly: The first-aid steps are in English only in this prototype.
guide.finished: All steps done. Stay with them and keep watching their breathing until help arrives.
guide.pending: {count} step(s) are saved on this phone only. They will reach the laptop when it is reachable.
evidence.guideSource: From the guide "{guide}", adapted from the IFRC 2020 first aid guidelines.
home.cardNote: Answers and times for the doctor
guard.title: Night guard
guard.lead: For someone who sleeps alone. If they can't speak, they can still ask for help.
guard.how1: Knock 3 times on the bed or table if you need help.
guard.how2: The phone asks loudly "Are you OK?" for 30 seconds.
guard.how3: If nobody taps "I'm OK", it phones the neighbour and texts the family.
guard.listening: Listening. Keep the phone near the bed and charging.
guard.webOnly: The night guard needs the AuraHealth Android app: a web page cannot listen while the phone sleeps or make calls. Check-ins below work here too.
guard.contactsNote: Phone numbers stay on this phone. They are never sent to the laptop.
guard.name: Name
guard.no112: Phones do not let any app call {number} by itself. The alert goes to people near you, and the big button calls {number}.
guard.checkinsNote: Tapping these tells the doctor when the person was last seen well.
guard.perm.fullscreen: Full-screen alert over the lock screen
guard.perm.battery: Battery saving may stop the night guard at night
alert.title: Are you OK?
alert.body: If nobody taps below, AuraHealth will phone {neighbour} and text {family} in {seconds} seconds.
alert.test: This is a test. Nobody will be called.
hub.title: Laptop AI helper
hub.note: Type the address and code shown in the laptop window (for example http://192.168.1.10:8000 and the code after code=). Leave it empty to use the app on its own.
guard.perm.batteryFix: Turn off battery saving for AuraHealth
